parsed.corrected_rationale: The answer begins with '7', which is the ordinal number of the reviewer comment, not a reference to section 7 of the paper. The comment itself never identifies any specific section, table, figure, or part of the paper; it only refers to a topic — the potential gap between the algorithmic recovery threshold and the information-theoretic one. However, it clearly specifies what needs to be addressed: an explicit discussion of the assumptions under which the gap is proven or conjectured. Since the authors cannot confidently determine which part of the paper the comment addresses, the comment is weakly grounded, though it is specific about the requested clarification.
